title: I turned my ESP32 into a treasure detector

lines.text: I turned my ESP32 into a treasure detector.
Somewhere on this knob, a treasure is hidden.
Far away, the light stays cold and blue.
Turn closer, and it starts to warm up.
And this little red LED beeps faster and faster, just like a metal detector.
Right here, it goes crazy. Press the button!
So how does it work? The knob gives the ESP32 a number, from zero to ninety-nine.
The code checks how far that number is from the secret one.
Then map() turns the distance into a color, and into a beep speed.
After every find, the treasure hides somewhere new.
You can build this with episodes one to eight. Can you find it faster than me?
